Growlithe

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Growlithe is a Fire-type Puppy Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 19 kg. It evolves into Arcanine. Its highest base stat is Attack (70), with a base stat total of 350.
